cues.zh: 再除以資料值的數量。

cues.en: Well it's a couple reasons.

cues.en: One is that we want the variance to indicate the dispersion around the average.

cues.en: All I did was just add 100 to each element here.
cues.zh: 我只是把這裡每個元素加上一百。

cues.en: So we want these two data sets to have the same variance because they have the same overall dispersion.
cues.zh: 所以，希望這兩組資料有相同變異數，因為整體離散程度相同。

cues.en: Why are the differences squared.

cues.en: It has some nice geometric properties.

cues.en: But also part of the reason is that we want the distances to the average.
